name: Chris Fleet
description: Scottish historic-map curator and visiting GeoCart 2018 contributor.
story: Cartographies of change: GeoCart 2018 proceedings, National Library of New Zealand record 40158196 lists Chris Fleet as an author of “Curating geospatial collections of the future”.

The GeoCart 2018 conference programme identifies Fleet as a map curator at the National Library of Scotland. He was invited to discuss curation of future geospatial collections and contribute expertise to a Wellington workshop on making historical maps available online. This is documented professional knowledge exchange with New Zealand map custodians, not evidence that Fleet worked for a New Zealand mapping agency.
